name: clock-out
about: The box keeps time, both directions. Out: the P4 sends its own MIDI clock at 120 BPM to robot a cable 0 and robot b cable 0, which only listen; each interval is checked against 120 BPM. In: robot a sends a 120 BPM clock on its cable 1, and the P4 passes it to robot b cable 1, checked against a's own grid. P4 config: its clock out to a cable 1 and b cable 1 (USB jacks), started before the run; a cable 2 -> b cable 2. ticks_min allows for the lead-in. For hours: --duration 8h.
